rules.segment_bounds: every segment lies inside its episode and lasts at least 3 s
rules.safe_cuts: no segment starts or ends inside a spoken line
rules.story_order: segments are in story order and do not overlap
rules.ids_exist: the hook and cliffhanger block ids exist
rules.hook_onset: the hook beat starts within 3 s of the promo start
rules.cliff_inside: the cliffhanger beat starts inside the last segment
